items.title: fix(doctor): repair unsupported Gateway Node runtimes (#181618)
items.summary: fix(doctor): repair unsupported Gateway Node runtimes (#181618) After a 2026.10.5 to 2026.10.6 update, a systemd user Gateway whose unit pinned an absolute Node that 2026.10.6 no longer supports kept crash-looping, and doctor --fix could not repair it: Doctor misclassified the %t runtime environment-file drop-in as an operator override and only repaired the service runtime interactively. Doctor now repairs a provably owned service (command matches the installed package root, no launcher override, only runtime/PATH findings; service platform passed explicitly) to the install plan's compatible Node in non-interactive mode through the existing backup and reconciliation owner, preserving unrelated drop-ins and refusing real PATH or launcher overrides. Current main already refuses the incompatible-Node update before staging or migration; docs now describe both. Fixes #181611, reported by @samueltardieu.

items.title: fix(fal): report unsupported video overrides for MiniMax and HeyGen i…
items.summary: fix(fal): report unsupported video overrides for MiniMax and HeyGen instead of claiming they were applied (#177687) fix(fal): report video overrides that Fal models ignore Fal MiniMax and HeyGen video requests silently dropped unsupported geometry and audio overrides, while the CLI and runtime metadata said no overrides were ignored; Kling and Wan similarly misreported unsupported audio. The request sent to Fal is unchanged; the reported ignoredOverrides now list what each model actually dropped. Evidence: built CLI against a local HTTP fixture standing in for Fal (with the private-network guard left on). For MiniMax and HeyGen, main reported ignored [] while the request carried only the prompt (twice); with this change the request is the same and ignored lists the geometry and audio overrides (twice). Kling and Wan now report ignored audio, Seedance reports nothing ignored for its supported fields, and the saved MP4 bytes are identical. A live gpt-5.4-mini run passes. Production +28/-2. Thanks @yetval. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空會員資料外洩逾1,177萬筆，近200個帳號的密碼遭改
items.summary: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空（Capcom）證實，旗下會員帳號服務CAPCOM ID遭第三方入侵，導致全球超過1,177萬筆會員資料外洩，其中有196個帳號的登入密碼遭擅自變更。卡普空表示，未發現會員自行設定的密碼外洩，信用卡資料也不在此次外洩範圍。 CAPCOM ID是卡普空旗下網路服務及部分線上遊戲使用的共用帳號。外洩資料包括會員電子郵件地址、帳號建立時間、最後登入時間、登入次數，以及最後登入時使用的IP位址，而有43筆還包含出生年月日、性別、國家或地區及暱稱。

items.title: 戶外用品業者歐都納接獲消費者反映疑似個資外洩，重訊指出委外平臺業者資料庫遭自動化攻擊
items.summary: 以戶外機能服飾、登山裝備及休閒用品為主要商品的興櫃公司歐都納（2940），於10月22日在公開資訊觀測站發布資安事件重大訊息，表示委外服務平臺業者的資料庫遭到自動化攻擊，部分資訊遭非法擷取，當日並接獲消費者反映疑似個資外洩。

items.title: 私鑰安全事故延燒，印度eMudhra宣布退出SSL/TLS憑證市場
items.summary: 印度數位憑證業者eMudhra週四（10/22）宣布，將退出全球SSL/TLS憑證市場。該公司日前被發現有8張中繼憑證授權機構（CA）憑證的私密金鑰存在嚴重安全問題，攻擊者可輕易還原私鑰，進而偽造網站憑證。這讓Google、蘋果、微軟及Mozilla等業者相繼封鎖有問題的中繼CA憑證，亦使得eMudhra最終決定退出憑證業務。
